blocking_owner_only.description: True when everything still blocking is outside what a fix step may change — a decision the developer owns, a rule that is itself wrong, access this Run does not have. False whenever one blocker remains that a fix round could close. Meaningless while `blocking` is false, and then always false.

status.description: `blocked` when a dependency a check needs was unavailable, so the work was not judged; the findings name what was missing and which checks did not run.
